notes: Datasheet SLFS022K covers NA555/NE555/SA555/SE555; only the 'NA555, NE555, SA555' rows are included, SE555 rows and SE555 full-temperature (TA = –55°C to +125°C) rows are excluded. Rows printed without a device qualifier (THRES current, RESET voltage level 0.3/0.7/1, RESET current at VCC, DISCH off-state current, VOL @ IOL=200mA, VOH @ IOH=–200mA) apply to all devices. RESET current at 0V is printed with negative sign (–0.4 typ / –1.5 max) and stored as printed. ABS_MAX VI max is the expression 'VCC' -> null. ±225/±200 mA stored as magnitudes. Thermal table D-column header is printed 'NA556, NE556, SA555, SE555' (datasheet typo for NA555/NE555). CONT is 'Input/output' in the pin table -> BIDIRECTIONAL, role REFERENCE. DISCH is open-collector output. Timing: only tr/tf are tabulated; the text also states a ~10µs minimum TRIG high time / minimum monostable pulse width (page 11, 'limits the minimum monostable pulse width to 10µs') and a 100kHz max recommended astable frequency, not included as table timing. Figure 5-8 'Propagation Delay Time' is a typical curve only (no tabulated value). Temperature coefficient / supply sensitivity of timing interval rows are in the Switching Characteristics table and are tagged ELECTRICAL.
